newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-EASTBOURNE WOMEN'S FINAL ABANDONED AFTER RAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EASTBOURNE WOMEN'S FINAL ABANDONED AFTER RAIN.

text.p: Rain forced the Eastbourne women's grasscourt final between Arantxa Sanchez Vicario and Jana Novotna to be abandoned after it was carried over into an extra day on Sunday.
Spain's Sanchez Vicario and her Czech opponent split the 48,000 pounds ($79,400) first prize after persistent showers prevented them completing even one set.
Novotna was leading 6-5 when the final was called off after she complained about the slippery court, though the Spaniard appeared ready to continue playing.
Rain had disrupted Saturday's scheduled last day of the pre-Wimbledon tournament.
